Security and Privacy Policy

Comprehensive data protection and security measures for your mental health journey

Last Updated: August 19, 2026 | Version: 4.0

Introduction

SafePsy ("we," "us," "our") is committed to protecting your privacy. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, disclose, and safeguard your information when you use our mental wellness platform.

SafePsy is a privacy-first mental wellness platform that helps people get private support between therapy sessions without giving up control of their data. We combine wallet-based identity, client-side encryption, and ethical AI to provide a confidential space for reflection and support.

User-Controlled Encryption

Your encryption keys are derived from your wallet, not stored on our servers

No Training on Your Data

Your conversations are never used to train AI models

Transparent Processing

This policy clearly explains what data is collected and why

Security Overview

SafePsy implements comprehensive security measures to protect user data, ensure privacy, and maintain system integrity. Our multi-layer security model is aligned with ISO/IEC 27001:2022 and provides enterprise-grade protection for your sensitive mental health information. We record security-relevant events (e.g. authentication) in audit logs with redacted identifiers for incident response and compliance.

A key differentiator: you own your data. We do not store it with third parties or use it to train AI models.

Guest mode and wallet mode

Guest mode lets you try the assistant without connecting a wallet. Guest conversations are not written to our databases, are not associated with any wallet or account, and exist only in your browser for that visit (a hard refresh starts a new session). We do not use guest message content for analytics or training. Operational logs avoid storing guest chat text.

Wallet mode (after you connect and verify a wallet) enables encrypted storage of your chat history, keys derived from your wallet, and continuity across sessions subject to our technical architecture and terms.

Optional product analytics (cookies)

When you enable analytics cookies, SafePsy may set a first-party cookie (sp_product_metrics) that holds anonymous ISO timestamps for funnel milestones only: landing session start, first wallet connect intent, wallet connected, verified wallet session, DID present, first chat message sent, first assistant reply completed, and whether you returned within 24 hours of a prior browser session. Values do not include wallet addresses, DIDs, names, email, IP, or message content. You can change or withdraw consent via our cookie banner and preference UI; disabling analytics removes this cookie.

Privacy by Design

SafePsy implements privacy-by-design principles throughout our platform. We minimize data collection, use encrypted at rest with client-side key management (server stores ciphertext only), provide granular consent controls, and ensure users maintain control over their personal information. Our architecture is built from the ground up to protect your privacy. Note: Server-side AI processing (Scaleway) requires temporary decryption in memory for chat completions.

ID token

What is an ID token?

SafePsy gives you complete control over your digital identity through an on-chain ID token (also called a Safe ID Token). Your ID token is a unique record stored on the blockchain that you own and control through your cryptocurrency wallet. Unlike traditional identity systems, your ID token is controlled by your wallet keys. Some lifecycle operations (e.g. revocation) are enforced by the smart contract rules and are recorded on-chain.

ID token benefits

User Ownership

You own and control your identity on the blockchain

Verifiable Credentials

Cryptographically verifiable identity without third-party verification

Privacy-Preserving

Minimal data exposure with selective disclosure

Portable Identity

Use your ID token across different platforms and services

ID token management

Blockchain Storage

Your ID token is stored on Ethereum blockchain, ensuring immutability and transparency

Wallet Control

Only you can manage your ID token through your wallet's private keys

Revocation Rights

You can revoke your ID token. Revocation is an on-chain lifecycle event and does not erase blockchain history.

Update Capability

Update your ID token information while maintaining cryptographic integrity

ID token privacy & security

Your ID token is cryptographically linked to your wallet address. SafePsy never stores your private keys and cannot access or modify your ID token without your explicit cryptographic signature. All ID token operations are recorded on the blockchain, providing a transparent and auditable identity management system. Your ID token data can be encrypted and stored securely, with only you holding the decryption keys.

AI assistant (mental wellness support)

AI Service Overview

SafePsy includes an AI assistant designed to complement human therapy sessions. Our AI assistant helps you prepare for sessions, reflect between appointments, and access guidance when needed. The AI is trained on psychology-informed principles and is designed to support, not replace, professional mental health care.

AI Limitations & Disclaimers

Not a Replacement for Professional Care: The AI assistant is designed to complement, not replace, professional mental health therapy. It should not be used as a substitute for professional diagnosis or treatment.

No Medical Advice: The AI assistant does not provide medical advice, diagnosis, or treatment. Always consult with licensed mental health professionals for clinical decisions.

Emergency Situations: The AI assistant is not equipped to handle mental health emergencies. If you are experiencing a crisis, please contact emergency services or a crisis hotline immediately.

Accuracy: While we strive for accuracy, AI responses may contain errors or be inappropriate for your specific situation. Use your judgment and consult professionals when needed.

When you interact with our AI assistant, the following data is processed:

  • Conversation history is stored encrypted in our systems for continuity
  • Usage metrics (token counts, response times) are logged for service improvement
  • No personal identifiers are shared with AI service providers beyond what's necessary for the conversation
  • You can request deletion of your AI conversation data at any time

Explicit Consent for Health Data Processing (GDPR Article 9)

SafePsy processes health-related information you voluntarily share during your conversations with our AI assistant. Under the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR), health data is classified as a special category of personal dataunder Article 9, which requires explicit consent for processing.

What This Consent Covers

By providing consent for health data processing, you agree to the following:

  • Your mental health-related messages and reflections are processed by our AI assistant to generate supportive responses
  • Your conversations are transmitted securely to our AI service provider (Scaleway) for real-time processing
  • Your health data is used solely for generating AI-powered reflection responses within this platform
  • Your conversations are not used to train AI models, sold to third parties, or shared for advertising purposes

Legal Basis

Article 6(1)(a) — Consent (General Data)

Your explicit consent forms the lawful basis for processing personal data through our platform, including identity verification and platform functionality.

Article 9(2)(a) — Explicit Consent (Health Data)

Your explicit, informed, and unambiguous consent is required before any health-related information you provide is processed. This consent is obtained through a dedicated consent flow that clearly explains what health data is processed, why it is needed, and your rights.

How Consent Is Obtained and Managed

Explicit Consent Flow

Before using the AI assistant, you must expressly check a dedicated consent checkbox confirming you understand and agree to health data processing. Consent is recorded with a timestamp for audit purposes.

Granular Control

Health data consent is separate from cookie consent. You can withdraw health data processing consent at any time through your privacy settings, which will not affect the processing of non-health data.

Right to Withdraw

You may withdraw your consent for health data processing at any time, for any reason. Withdrawal is immediate and does not affect the lawfulness of processing based on consent before its withdrawal. Upon withdrawal, your health data will no longer be processed by the AI assistant.

Important: Health data consent is required to use the AI assistant features. Without this consent, you may still browse the platform, but the AI-powered reflection functionality will not be available. Your data is encrypted in transit and processed through Scaleway's Zero Data Retention generative APIs, which do not retain or use prompts to train models.

Privacy by Design: IP Address Handling

Default OFF for Maximum Privacy

SafePsy follows privacy by design principles with IP address handling. By default, IP hashing is **disabled** to ensure maximum privacy protection. IP hashing must be explicitly enabled via environment variables if needed for abuse prevention.

When IP Hashing is OFF (Default)

No SHA-256 hash computed

IP addresses are not stored in any form

Raw IPs not written to database

Database columns store null/undefined

Logs redacted in production

IP field replaced with <REDACTED: ip>

When IP Hashing is ON (Opt-in)

SHA-256 with configurable salt

Hash computed as SHA-256(ip + IP_SALT)

Salt must be ≥32 characters

Validated at startup; hashing refused if invalid

Stored in database for abuse prevention

Enables correlation without exposing raw IPs

Environment Configuration

IP_HASHING_ENABLED=false # Default: OFF for maximum privacy

IP_SALT=your-secure-salt-here # Must be ≥32 characters (use: openssl rand -hex 32)

Security Considerations

  • Use a strong, unique salt in production (generate with: openssl rand -hex 32)
  • Rotate salt regularly for enhanced security
  • Rate limiting remains effective with or without IP hashing
  • Default OFF ensures maximum privacy protection

Blockchain and On-Chain Data

What Is Stored On-Chain

SafePsy uses blockchain (Ethereum Sepolia testnet) to store Decentralized Identifiers (DIDs) and related metadata. Understanding what is stored on-chain helps you make informed decisions about your privacy.

Privacy Implications

  • Public metadata: Someone who knows your wallet address can see that you have a DID token
  • Permanent record: On-chain data cannot be deleted due to blockchain immutability
  • Content remains private: Only hashes and references are on-chain, not message content
  • Linkage possible: Events indexed by tokenId can be linked to the same DID across time

Revocation

You can revoke your DID token from your profile page. Revocation is permanent and cannot be undone. Revoked addresses cannot mint a new DID token. Revocation is recorded on-chain as permanent metadata, but off-chain data (encrypted chat) can still be deleted.

Content Privacy

  • User content encrypted before off-chain storage (AES-256-GCM)
  • Key material on-chain in DID profile field (encryptedKeyMetadata)
  • On-chain references use cryptographic hashes only (not content)
  • Completions use separate plaintext-over-TLS path for AI processing

Off-Chain Data

  • Encrypted content payloads (chat messages, summaries)
  • Message bodies (encrypted and stored off-chain)
  • Private user attributes (encrypted before storage)
  • Application-level analytics (not stored on-chain)

Right to Erasure and Blockchain Limitations

SafePsy complies with your right to erasure under GDPR Article 17. However, because SafePsy uses blockchain technology for decentralized identity, some data cannot be technically deleted. This section explains exactly what is deleted, what remains, and why.

What Is Deleted

When you request account deletion via DELETE /api/account, SafePsy permanently removes the following off-chain data:

  • Encrypted chat history — All chat messages, keys, and summaries stored in our database
  • Subscription and payment records — All billing information, Stripe data, and crypto payment records
  • Crisis opt-in data — Your name, email address, and emergency contact information
  • RAG audit logs — All records of document indexing and retrieval operations associated with your wallet
  • Consent records — All records of consent grants and withdrawals stored in our database
  • Active sessions — All active authentication sessions are invalidated

What Cannot Technically Be Deleted

The following data exists on the Ethereum blockchain and cannot be modified or removed due to blockchain immutability:

  • DID token IDs and hashes — These are cryptographic commitments (SHA-256 hashes) that do not contain personal information
  • Wallet addresses — Your wallet address is pseudonymous and not directly identifiable without your action to link it to your identity
  • DID lifecycle events — Records of DID minting, revocation, and key updates are permanent event logs
  • Encrypted key metadata — An encrypted blob (`{signature}:{iv}:ciphertext`) that is cryptographically unreadable without your wallet
  • Service endpoint URLs — Public infrastructure URLs for DID Document resolution
  • Data and key hashes — One-way hashes that cannot be reverse-engineered to identify any individual

Why It Remains

Ethereum blockchain immutability. Data committed to a block cannot be modified or removed. This is a fundamental property of the blockchain, not a design choice.

Cryptographic integrity. On-chain data consists of hashes and cryptographic commitments. These exist to verify system behavior and ensure data integrity — not to identify individuals.

No personal data on-chain. SafePsy does not store raw personal information (health data, names, emails, IP addresses, chat messages) on the blockchain. All on-chain data is either purely non-personal (hashes, opaque identifiers) or pseudonymous (wallet-address indexed).

Legal Basis for On-Chain Retention

GDPR Article 6(1)(f) — Legitimate interest: Blockchain audit trails ensure system integrity and prevent fraud (e.g., duplicate DID minting after revocation, unauthorized key modifications).

GDPR Article 17(3)(d) — Legal claims: On-chain records may serve as evidence in legal disputes concerning identity verification or access control.

No material conflict: Because on-chain data contains no raw personal information, the retention of this data does not materially conflict with the right to erasure. The personal data (off-chain records) is fully deleted.

How SafePsy Minimizes On-Chain Identification

  • No raw PII on-chain. Health data, chat messages, email addresses, names, and IP addresses are NEVER stored on the blockchain.
  • Hash-only references. All data pointers are one-way cryptographic hashes that cannot be reverse-engineered.
  • Encrypted key blobs. The encryptedKeyMetadata field stores only an AES key wrapped by a wallet-derived KEK. Without the user's wallet to re-derive the KEK, the blob is unintelligible.
  • Pseudonymous identifiers. Wallet addresses are pseudonymous — they do not directly identify a natural person.
  • Separate off-chain storage. All encrypted content payloads, message bodies, and private user attributes are stored off-chain and are fully deleted on erasure.

Effect on Your Ability to Decrypt and Access Data

After erasure, your ability to decrypt and access previously stored data is permanently lost. Here is why:

  1. When you create a DID, an AES key is wrapped (encrypted) with a Key Encryption Key (KEK) derived from your wallet signature. This wrapped key is stored on-chain as encryptedKeyMetadata.
  2. Off-chain, SafePsy stores references that link this encrypted key to your encrypted chat data.
  3. When you request erasure, SafePsy severs ALL database references between your wallet and your data.
  4. The encrypted key metadata remains on-chain, but SafePsy no longer holds the database records needed to use it. Even if you still control your wallet and can decrypt the blob, the data it points to no longer exists.
  5. Key unlinking = permanent loss of access to all previously stored encrypted data. This cannot be undone.

Please confirm you understand this consequence before proceeding with account deletion.

Optional: DID Token Revocation

You may optionally revoke your DID token from your profile page. Revocation is permanent and cannot be undone. The revocation event (burning the token and adding your wallet address to the permanent revocation list) is recorded on-chain. Off-chain, the revocation prevents your wallet from minting a new DID.

Note: Revocation does NOT delete any on-chain data. The DID minting event, token ID, and hash remain permanently on-chain regardless of revocation status.
